title: My Son-In-Law Forged A Dissolution And Sold My $134K Roastery For $640K. So I Let It Unravel
description: After 30 years as a school administrative assistant, I put my entire $134,000 pension into a small batch coffee roastery with my son-in-law. He forged a dissolution, sold the contracts and inventory for $640,000, and mailed me a $4,200 chaff check. I found the notarized agreement hidden in the hopper lid and let the whole sale unravel. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #CoffeeBusiness
thumb_text: HE SOLD MY PENSION AND CALLED IT CHAFF
pinned_comment: If your son-in-law forged a dissolution and sold your $134,000 coffee roastery for $640,000, then mailed you a $4,200 chaff check, what would you have done? Tell me in the comments if you have ever found the one piece of paper that unraveled everything.
